about.title: About me
paragraphs: I'm Dylan Ezequiel Gómez, a Computer Technician and software developer.

I build modern, functional and scalable digital products, mainly web and mobile applications. I work with React, TypeScript, Node.js and the JavaScript ecosystem, combining frontend and backend development.
I'm focused on turning problems and ideas into concrete software solutions, incorporating tools like Artificial Intelligence when they truly add value to the product.
That approach led me to develop software solutions with real impact, recognized in educational spaces like the 2025 Science and Technology Fair.
I'm currently looking to keep growing professionally through projects, collaborations and opportunities within software development.

list.title: BARRA | Gym Management SaaS
list.description: Multi-gym SaaS that ends spreadsheets: a desktop CRM to manage clients, billing, routines and attendance, plus a mobile app for members with tappable routines, QR check-in stamps and self-service plan renewal.

list.title: TRAVIO AI | Web App
list.description: Full-Stack e2e web application that uses Artificial Intelligence (Gemini API) to generate fully personalized travel itineraries in seconds based on the user's budget and interests.

list.title: Almacén Preciso | Mobile App
list.description: Mobile app that streamlines operational communication between store owners and staff: report out-of-stock items instantly, approve or reject restocks with one tap, and track real-time metrics with push notifications.

list.title: YF Portfolio | Personal Website
list.description: Landing page to showcase skills, projects and contact for a professional photographer.

list.title: SIA-TEC | App
list.description: An application for hospital appointment management with Artificial Intelligence.

list.title: Aberturas MG | E-commerce Store
list.description: A product catalog for a business called Aberturas MG, integrated with WhatsApp.

list.title: SIA-TEC | Blog
list.description: Blog developed for the SIA-TEC school project, a platform focused on AI-powered automated hospital appointment management.

list.title: 📰El Diario Sur
list.description: I collaborated on the development of SIA-TEC, a system to automate healthcare at primary care centers (CAPS). The project was highlighted by El Diario Sur due to its impact on the community and the optimization of medical shift wait times.

list.title: 💻CoreByte
list.description: I developed the Frontend architecture of this school application together with a teacher. The system allows teacher administration and enrollment of students in technology classes, prioritizing an intuitive interface for the user.
